title: Rotary position embeddings
hints: Frequencies: inv_freq = base ** (-np.arange(0, d, 2) / d), shape (d/2,). The angle table is positions[:, None] * inv_freq[None, :], shape (T, d/2).
Take the even and odd columns x[..., 0::2] and x[..., 1::2] as the two coordinates of each pair and rotate: (x1 * cos - x2 * sin, x1 * sin + x2 * cos).
Interleave the two halves back with np.stack((r1, r2), axis=-1).reshape(x.shape).
